analyst_view.overall: PSG lead Ligue 1, have won six league games in a row and beat Villarreal 6-0 in midweek, but they are without Dembélé, Kvaratskhelia, Marquinhos, Nuno Mendes and Akliouche. Hakimi is also rested until the international break, which the site does not count. Troyes are 16th and have failed to score in five of nine games, but they have kept two clean sheets in a row, and their coach says they won't park the bus.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Without Hakimi as well as Dembélé and Kvaratskhelia, PSG's attack is short of key players, and Troyes have kept two clean sheets in a row, so we lean slightly lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners. PSG will have long spells of possession against a side sitting in its own half, which tends to produce corners, so we lean higher.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards. We could not confirm the referee or find anything pointing to a heated game, so we stay level.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.5 shots. PSG's dominance should hold even with rotation, as the numbers expect.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.7 shots on target. With so many first-choice attackers out, we expect fewer clean chances than PSG's recent run suggests, so we lean slightly lower.
